title: Projects
subtitle: Things I've built with Claude as a coding partner. This page refreshes itself every week.

projects.name: Daily Reads
projects.tagline: A curated daily email of things worth reading.
projects.description: Collects articles from RSS feeds, a personal source list and newsletters in Gmail. Claude picks the best five and writes a short blurb for each. The email also adds the day's weather, reminders of upcoming dates found in the inbox, and one-click calendar buttons.

projects.name: School Update
projects.tagline: A daily digest of school emails, filtered to what applies.
projects.description: Reads school emails from a Gmail label and has Claude keep only what applies to the family, sorted into things needing action, upcoming dates, and news. Adds links to sign-up forms and video meetings, plus one-click calendar buttons. It only sends when something is relevant.

projects.name: Assignment Dashboard
projects.tagline: Every assignment across all courses, in one color-coded page.
projects.description: Pulls assignments and calendar events from the Canvas learning platform API, builds a filterable, color-coded page with urgency indicators, publishes it to GitHub Pages behind a password, and emails an evening digest.

projects.name: Analytics Debugger
projects.tagline: A DevTools panel that makes web-analytics requests readable.
projects.description: A Chrome extension that captures analytics upload requests as a page loads and shows them in a readable panel inside the browser's developer tools, so they can be inspected without digging through raw network logs.
projects.runs: Runs in the browser while debugging

projects.name: Writing
projects.tagline: Notes on building with AI as a non-developer.
projects.description: A LinkedIn project entry and a Medium article about going from an idea to a working, automated app with Claude as a coding partner, written from the point of view of a data analyst rather than a software developer.
